subject: im
question: What is the full form of GOLF? (inventory classification: Government, Ordinary, Local, Foreign)
title: GOLF: Distance Decides Stock
hook: Cooking gas, rice, vegetables, an imported spice: four items, four sources.
answer: It classifies inventory by its source of supply.
G: items supplied or controlled by the government (government rules, slow).
O: ordinary items easily bought from the open market from many suppliers.
L: local items from nearby suppliers (quick delivery, small frequent orders).
F: foreign items, imported (long lead time, so order early and keep extra safety stock).

Cooking gas comes through a government-controlled supply. Rice and salt come from the open market. Vegetables come from the corner shop. And one special spice is imported from another country. Ordinary items come from the open market. Local items come from nearby suppliers. Foreign items are imported. And to remember: golf is a game of distance, the farther the source, the more stock.
